reviewer: coordinator, already aware of the target paper and all development data
scope: Manual review of the twelve preserved actor replies; not blinded scoring or a replicated efficacy estimate.

milestones.finding: Two candidate paths (template/product heterogeneity and amplification carryover) were retained with unknown links identified. The released observations did not distinguish the paths; matched interventions were unavailable. No executed discriminating mechanistic test.

Closed descriptive time functions were fitted. The mechanistic balance equations retain undefined source, loss and exchange functions and lack phase-volume and observation closure; no executable mechanistic model of cavity emergence.

Five requested computation jobs completed: sequence alignment, time fits, source-schema/measurement-definition check, partition ratios, retrospective time fits. The schema check is availability/measurement work, not a physical discovery computation.

The researcher specified families, constraints and equal-weight objective; coordinator executed multistart fitting. No mechanistic coefficients fitted, no profile-likelihood analysis performed. Boundary behavior and window sensitivity were noticed.

Two-compartment balance and cancellation of exchange upon summing were written, and measured partition ratios calculated. No dynamical onset threshold, stability criterion, phase diagram, critical radius or derived concentration-to-area prediction.

Model limitations and two factual errors were explicitly revised. A linear comparator was retained and final model choice changed; there was no new mechanistic structure in response to the observed limitations. Errors corrected by coordinator feedback remain in original replies.

Four final numeric commitments frozen before scoring the within-run reserved 36/48h measurements. Coverage 4/4. Mean absolute error 0.590276 percentage points; B48 error 1.989891 percentage points. No predeclared accuracy threshold and no independent new-data claim.

No sequence-to-functional-connectivity calculation, no coupled production/exchange/slow-diffusion concentration-gradient model, no local spinodal-instability derivation, no quantitative cavity-onset condition. Generic phase partition and balance alone do not recover the publication's mechanism.
